entries.0ef8e9fec09fe94a: This is a single-segment business that sells bicycles and related products such as parts and accessories at stores and provides ancillary services such as various maintenance and repairs. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥81,374 million. As of February 20, 2026, it operates 539 directly managed stores from Hokkaido to Kyushu and has 18 franchise stores in the Chubu, Kinki and Kyushu regions. It also conducts internet mail-order sales and a wholesale business supplying products to domestic dealers.

entries.6256468d9db19737: The management philosophy is “We aim to be a company that contributes to people around the world through bicycles”, and the basic policy is to achieve both “realization of a sustainable society” and “sustainable growth of the company”. The medium-term management plan “VISION2028”, covering the fiscal years from the year ending February 2027 to the year ending February 2029, sets “deepening existing businesses”, “exploring and challenging peripheral business areas” and “human resource management in which diverse talent can thrive” as its three pillars; through deepening the OMO foundation and expanding peripheral business areas such as the reuse business and the repair and maintenance business, it states that it will promote a circular business model that does not depend solely on new bicycle sales.

entries.bcf845b5e5023fab: It cites as the company's strengths its nationwide store network, the OMO foundation integrating EC and stores, repair and maintenance functions, its logistics system and its human resource development foundation, and states that it will further strengthen these. In addition, it has built an SPA value chain in which products the company plans and develops are manufactured by overseas manufacturers, and has strengthened coordination from product development through to sales.
entries.be05cf5a0ad43f54: The company has a single segment, the bicycle business, and its net sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥81,374 million. By product, sales to external customers were bicycles ¥57,289 million, parts and accessories ¥14,000 million, other (incidental services such as maintenance and repair and long-term warranty services, etc.) ¥9,951 million, and royalties ¥133 million. Sales to external customers in Japan exceed 90% of net sales, and no counterparty accounts for 10% or more of total sales.
